description: Start a scout application for the signed-in user. Scouts are trusted people in a niche (growth people, marketers, fractional CMOs, founders) who earn when a founder they introduce becomes a client. Free; the user can be brand new. Ask for at least an X handle or a LinkedIn URL (a site and free-text references help). If they came from another scout's invite link or gave you an invite code (looks like ERAN-7K2Q), pass it as invite_code. This reads ONLY the public profiles they give and drafts an editable profile; it takes about 30-150 seconds and this tool waits up to ~75s. Then show the user the draft (headline, niches, audience, who they can reach, tone, never-pitch list) and what was found, take their edits, ask how they want to work (channels: public_replies / dms / intros; deals per day: 1 / 3 / 5), and call submit_scout_application. Nothing is used until they submit, and a person at ProductClank reviews every scout. Call get_scout_application FIRST if they may have applied before: a rebuild clears an earlier submit. Max 3 builds per day.

invite_code.description: Another scout's invite code, if the user has one.

references.description: Free text: past clients, communities, newsletters, portfolio links.

x_handle.description: The user's X handle, with or without @.
